book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: كانت وحدة من البنات الحلوين اللي بيولدوا بالغلط بعيلة موظفين.
sentences.en: She was one of those pretty girls who are born by mistake into a family of clerks.

sentences.ar: ما إلها مهر، ولا اسم، ولا طريق لرجل غني.
sentences.en: No dowry, no name, no way to a rich man.

sentences.ar: فتزوجت موظف زغير بوزارة التعليم، اسمه لوازيل.
sentences.en: So she married a small clerk at the Ministry of Education, named Loisel.
And she suffered all the time.

sentences.ar: من الحيطان الفقيرة، والكراسي القديمة، والستاير الرخيصة.
sentences.en: From the poor walls, the old chairs, the cheap curtains.

sentences.ar: وكانت تحلم بصالونات كبيرة، وخدم، وفساتين، ونسوان بيحسدوها.
sentences.en: And she dreamed of grand salons, and servants, and gowns, and women envying her.

sentences.ar: وما كان عندها صديقة إلا وحدة، غنية، من أيام المدرسة، وما كانت تزورها.
sentences.en: And she had only one friend, rich, from school days, and never visited her.

sentences.ar: لأنها كانت ترجع من عندها وتبكي أيام.
sentences.en: Because she came back from her and cried for days.

sentences.ar: وبمسا، رجع زوجها، وبإيده مغلف كبير، ووجهه مبسوط.
sentences.en: And one evening, her husband came home, a big envelope in his hand, his face pleased.
He said: look.
An invitation!
To the minister's ball!

sentences.ar: ورمت الدعوة عالطاولة، وقالت: وشو بدي أعمل فيها؟
sentences.en: And she threw the invitation on the table, and said: and what am I to do with it?
He said: I thought you would be glad.
Everyone wants this invitation.
She said, tears in her eyes: and what shall I wear?
I have no dress.

sentences.ar: وسكت الزوج، وبعدين قال: كم بيكلف فستان؟
sentences.en: And the husband was silent, and then said: how much would a dress cost?
A simple dress.
She thought, and said: four hundred francs.

sentences.ar: وهو صار وجهه أصفر، لأنه كان مخبي أربعمية فرنك بالضبط، عشان بندقية صيد.
sentences.en: And his face went pale, because he had saved exactly four hundred francs, for a hunting gun.
But he said: fine.
Four hundred.
And days before the ball, she was crying again.
She said: I have no jewels.
Not one stone.

sentences.ar: رح أبين فقيرة بين كل النسوان.
sentences.en: I will look poor among all the women.
He said: wear flowers.
She said: no.

sentences.ar: ما في أذل من الفقر بين الغنى.
sentences.en: There is nothing more humiliating than poverty among wealth.

sentences.ar: قال: روحي لصديقتك، السيدة فوريستييه، واستعيري شي.
sentences.en: He said: go to your friend, Madame Forestier, and borrow something.

sentences.ar: وراحت، وصديقتها فتحت صندوق، وقالت: اختاري.
sentences.en: And she went, and her friend opened a box, and said: choose.

sentences.ar: وشافت عقد من ألماس، بصندوق أسود، وقلبها دق.
sentences.en: And she saw a diamond necklace, in a black case, and her heart pounded.

sentences.ar: قالت، وصوتها بيرجف: بتقدري تعيريني هاد؟
sentences.en: She said, her voice shaking: could you lend me this?
Only this?
The friend said: certainly.
And at the ball, she was the loveliest of all.

sentences.ar: رقصت مع الوزرا، والكل سأل عنها، والوزير نفسه لاحظها.
sentences.en: She danced with ministers, everyone asked about her, the minister himself noticed her.

sentences.ar: ونسيت كل شي، وعاشت الليلة اللي حلمت فيها كل عمرها.
sentences.en: And she forgot everything, and lived the night she had dreamed of all her life.

sentences.ar: والساعة أربعة الصبح، طلعوا، وزوجها حط على كتافها معطفها القديم، واستحت.
sentences.en: And at four in the morning, they left, and her husband put her old coat on her shoulders, and she was ashamed.

sentences.ar: وركضت من الحفلة، عشان ما تشوفها النسوان بالمعطف.
sentences.en: And she ran from the ball, so the women would not see her in the coat.

sentences.ar: وبالبيت، وقفت قدام المراية، عشان تشوف حالها مرة أخيرة.
sentences.en: And at home, she stood before the mirror, to see herself one last time.
And screamed.
The necklace was not on her neck.
They searched the clothes, the pockets, the road, the cab.
Nothing.

sentences.ar: وراح الزوج للشرطة، وللجرايد، وشركة العربيات.
sentences.en: And the husband went to the police, the newspapers, the cab companies.
Nothing.

sentences.ar: وبعد أسبوع، قال: لازم نشتري واحد زيه.
sentences.en: And after a week, he said: we must buy one like it.

sentences.ar: ولقوا واحد زيه بالضبط، بمحل، بستة وتلاتين ألف فرنك.
sentences.en: And they found one exactly like it, in a shop, for thirty-six thousand francs.

sentences.ar: وكان عندهم تمانتعشر ألف، ورثها من أبوه.
sentences.en: And they had eighteen thousand, inherited from his father.
And the rest they borrowed.
From everyone.
At any interest.
On any terms.

sentences.ar: ورجعت العقد لصديقتها، وصديقتها ما فتحت الصندوق حتى.
sentences.en: And she returned the necklace to her friend, and her friend did not even open the case.
And said: you are late.
I needed it.
And the terrible life of the poor began.

sentences.ar: تركوا الشقة، وسكنوا بأوضة تحت السطح.
sentences.en: They left the flat, and lived in a room under the roof.

sentences.ar: وهي غسلت، وطبخت، وحملت المي عالدرج، ووقفت بالسوق تتخانق على قرش.
sentences.en: And she washed, and cooked, and carried water up the stairs, and stood in the market fighting over a penny.

sentences.ar: وهو اشتغل بالليل ينسخ أوراق بخمس قروش الصفحة.
sentences.en: And he worked at night copying papers at five sous a page.
Ten years.

sentences.ar: وبعد عشر سنين، سددوا كل شي.
sentences.en: And after ten years, they had paid everything.
Every franc, and every interest.

sentences.ar: وكانت هي صارت مرا عجوز، قوية، خشنة، شعرها مش ممشط، وإيديها حمر.
sentences.en: And she had become an old woman, strong, coarse, her hair uncombed, her hands red.

sentences.ar: بس أحياناً، كانت تقعد عالشباك، وتتذكر تلك الليلة.
sentences.en: But sometimes, she sat at the window, and remembered that night.
And thought: had the necklace not been lost.
What would have happened?
Who knows?

sentences.ar: وبيوم أحد، وهي ماشية بالحديقة، شافت السيدة فوريستييه.
sentences.en: And one Sunday, walking in the park, she saw Madame Forestier.
Still young, still lovely.

sentences.ar: وقربت منها، وقالت: مرحبا يا جان.
sentences.en: And approached her, and said: hello, Jeanne.

sentences.ar: والصديقة ما عرفتها، وقالت: يا سيدتي...
sentences.en: And the friend did not know her, and said: madame...
I do not know you.
She said: I am Mathilde Loisel.
The friend cried: Mathilde!
What has happened to you?
She said: a great deal.
And all because of you.
And told her.

sentences.ar: العقد، والضياع، والتلاتين ألف، والعشر سنين.
sentences.en: The necklace, the loss, the thirty thousand, the ten years.
And said proudly: and we paid it all.
It is done.

sentences.ar: والسيدة فوريستييه وقفت، ومسكت إيديها، وقالت:
sentences.en: And Madame Forestier stood, took both her hands, and said:
Oh, my poor Mathilde!
My necklace was false.
It was worth five hundred francs at most.
